scope.description: Sixteen exact direct composition cases; partial original-fidelity obligations, all inventory closures OPEN. Not the smoke matrix or a whole-control denominator.
scope.review: Original eight cases and 51 assessments retained unchanged. Independent automated root/Astra review approved eight additional finite cases and 83 obligations at draft scope digest 659a655e87bbb0642aa200cf108671ec93d9e2cd00f48577bfb97cd4df1b30e3 on 2026-10-18; final digest reflects only replacement of pending review labels. All closures remain OPEN; not human capture attestation.

evidence.locator: The 2.3.1 slice path at 0x10904..0x1091a passes cinf +6/+8 coordinates to the pixel sampler, then 0x109b2 supplies sampled RGB to RGBBackColor.
evidence.claim: Background RGB is sampled at authored cinf coordinates.
evidence.limits: Narrow source sample contract; does not prove full painter.

evidence.locator: The 2.3.1 default-ring path at 0x7698..0x76a2 expands the face rectangle by four pixels on each side before ring dispatch at 0x76c4.
evidence.claim: Ring destination expands face rect by four on each side.
evidence.limits: Synthetic case allocation only; not a whole ring certificate.

evidence.locator: The slice path at 0x10c18..0x10c28 retains square corner-size blocks; side thickness independently governs edge bands.
evidence.claim: Corner size and edge thickness are independent.
evidence.limits: Only exact source-coordinate sentinels independently asserted here.

evidence.locator: The Windows95 horizontal groove is 5x4 and thumb sheet is 11x64; the vertical groove is 4x5 and thumb sheet is 64x11. Four decoded cells yield native thumb cross sizes 16 and 16.
evidence.limits: Shared decoder; original decoding/state mapping/mask/placement not verified.

evidence.locator: 1138 rear cicn -9975 is 23x16 with opaque x2..20 and cinf corner10; 1990 rear cicn -9975 is 32x16 with opaque x1..28 and cinf corner14. Applying those original corner sizes after opaque cropping yields middle widths -1 and 0.
evidence.claim: Original source corner coordinates must not be applied to a smaller cropped source extent.
evidence.limits: Does not establish complete historical tab drawer or font.

evidence.locator: Apple Lisa active cicn -10239 is 9x9 with cinf corner4/side1. The original square4x4 corner rule retains source(2,2); the rectangular4x1 face slicer can substitute source(2,1).
evidence.limits: Exact normal empty minWidth80/height20 scope. Verifies decoded square-corner retention only, not full face/text/pattern, decoder or state selection.

evidence.locator: At 0x10922..0x10934, selected cinf +10/+12 coordinates supply the text RGB output; fc5c samples local raster coordinates and continues RGB lookup independently of the mask bit.
evidence.claim: Selected authored text RGB16 is sampled independently of source mask alpha.
evidence.limits: Exact finite source-model claim only. Original lookup, complete decoder/paint behavior, device/transfer, typography and actual port context remain unknown.

evidence.locator: At 0x1093e..0x10990, emboss coordinates (0,0) or exact three-word RGB16 equality with background disable emboss; the caller tests the raw red 0x1234 sentinel before display conversion.
evidence.claim: Exact absent/equal/sentinel decisions precede RGB8/display conversion.
evidence.limits: Exact finite source-model claim only. Original lookup, complete decoder/paint behavior, device/transfer, typography and actual port context remain unknown.

evidence.locator: Push 0x75ca..0x75ea with 0x70a6..0x70ba and bevel 0x89bc..0x8a08 paint enabled emboss at (+1,+1) before foreground; this establishes pass order and relative offset, not browser glyph or TextMode equivalence.
evidence.limits: Exact finite source-model claim only. Original lookup, complete decoder/paint behavior, device/transfer, typography and actual port context remain unknown.

evidence.locator: The 0x10ac8..0x10af6 corner anchors use original exclusive Rect edges; f930 translates both destination and finite clip by -P while changing origin to O-P, leaving physical D-O unchanged.
evidence.claim: Original face Rect phase, shared inset phase and clip transformation.
evidence.limits: Exact finite source-model claim only. Original lookup, complete decoder/paint behavior, device/transfer, typography and actual port context remain unknown.

evidence.locator: Crayon selected active push -10239 and small bevel -10175 text RGB16 is (8481,8481,8481); inactive push -10240 is (34952,34952,34952). Their emboss coordinate is (0,0). Exact cicn/cinf payload hashes and sample coordinates are pinned in tests/decoder-fixtures/control-text-source-samples.json.
evidence.claim: Exact selected source samples and absent emboss for the three declared Crayon cases.
evidence.limits: Exact finite source-model claim only. Original lookup, complete decoder/paint behavior, device/transfer, typography and actual port context remain unknown.

evidence.locator: Crayon ppat17 payload SHA256 35c7aa22b9da7e01f83fa5dbd6443e5c93459a3450401ab2c18050f37cdcfea4 has raw RGB samples (231,222,198) at (8,8), (247,247,214) at (63,9), and (247,239,214) at (0,9). The current display policy maps these to (235,228,207), (248,248,221), and (248,242,221).
evidence.claim: Three actual selected-pattern samples under declared transform only.
evidence.limits: Exact finite source-model claim only. Original lookup, complete decoder/paint behavior, device/transfer, typography and actual port context remain unknown.

evidence.locator: At 0x108a6..0x108b0, d3/d4 read cinf corner/side bytes. 0x10afa..0x10b10 copies the original Rect and insets left/right by corner, top/bottom by side, then 0x10b22 calls f930. If corner differs from side (0x10b26..0x10b2c), 0x10b2e..0x10b44 copies the original Rect again with transposed insets and 0x10b56 fills it using the same pattern and phase arguments. The body coverage is the union of these two rectangles.
evidence.claim: Two unequal corner/side inset rectangles are filled with shared phase; the literal 29x9 endpoint fixture checks their full union.
evidence.limits: Finite body geometry/source-phase requirement only. Original resource lookup, device color, mask branches and actual port remain unknown.

evidence.locator: Apple Universal Interfaces 3.4.1 QDSetPatternOrigin documents Rect(3,3,10,10) sampling the lower-right 7x7 of a 10x10 tile and SetOrigin(+10,+10) paired with pattern origin (-10,-10) preserving content alignment. These examples support additive R in sample(q)=floorMod(D.origin+q-P+R,tile dimensions); the K2 f930 wrapper alone establishes only the -P translation, not preexisting R.
evidence.claim: Additive sampling offset convention from the pinned API examples.
evidence.limits: API availability and actual R in any original environment are not established. Synthetic known R is a declared arithmetic input, not historical capture metadata.

evidence.locator: CDEF 8 reads the full cicn PixMap bounds at 0x420..0x42a, copies full-height end strips at 0x430..0x47e, and paints independent top/bottom bands at 0x484..0x552. When cinf tileSides is zero, 0x4a2..0x4b4 and 0x506..0x518 reduce the band source to its first column. 1138 rear art is 23x16 with corner10/side10; 1990 rear is 32x16 with corner14/side14. Both have empty centers and overlapping bands, so preserving full source coordinates retains their middle strips without repeating the adjacent semantic sample column.
evidence.claim: Full source coordinates and first-column bands retain the middle strips in the two exact unselected AgjpQy cases.
evidence.limits: Tests compare body pixels outside the current browser glyph mask; separate empty-label/literal fixtures cover whole body coordinates. Expected archive catalog bindings are not actual tab paint traces. Original selection, font, layout, device/transfer and pattern-center behavior remain unknown.

requirements.claim: Resolve original resource/base selection for this exact case.
Other source border/slicing geometry matches original behavior.
Remaining interior fill and transparent-mask behavior matches original.
Selected original state/cell mapping is independently established.
Original control/art placement and caller sizing policy is independently established.
Original font, size, ink and label placement are independently established.
For this empty20px face, output center equals authored source background sample.
Default-ring allocation expands the face rectangle by four pixels per side.
Corner3/side1 retains source(2,2) at destination(2,2).
Retains every opaque pixel of the decoded selected thumb cell; no decoder/state/placement certification.
Do not lose the middle strip by mixing original corner sizes with opaque-cropped source extents.
Retain square authored corner blocks independently of side thickness.
Original destination palette/device mapping and producer/display transform are independently established.
Consume the selected face's independently pinned authored RGB16 text sample under the explicitly declared current display policy; not original displayed-color fidelity.
Apply the exact source RGB16/coordinate/sentinel emboss enable-or-disable decision for this selected input.
At the exact opaque/zero browser-mask probes, paint enabled emboss first at (+1,+1) relative to foreground, then foreground; no original glyph or transfer-mode claim.
Original QuickDraw text transfer, low-depth disabled and anti-aliased overlap behavior are independently established.
Actual original port origin, pattern offset, clip and valid caller environment are independently established.
Use the original face Rect and declared pattern offset for exact source-derived phase samples; ring reservation does not shift phase.
Every pixel in the specified 29x9 literal fixture matches the two unequal-inset body rectangles with their shared phase.
For the specified finite clip, retain the two probed interior samples and exclude four named outside face/ring sentinels; remaining clipped raster is unknown.
Consume the actual selected ppat payload and match three independently pinned raw source samples under the declared current display transform; not original lookup/device-color fidelity.

Explicit40px face allocation plus exact corner3/side1 source coordinate.
Every decoded opaque cell pixel retained; test also checks project placement policy without claiming historical proof.
Retain all four Lisa source corner blocks (alpha and opaque colors) for normal empty label, minWidth80 and height20. No other face requirement inferred.
